title: Riacho Conecta
lead: Free training in digital tools, in the town.
paragraphs: Riacho Conecta is the first programme we want to stand up after the house. The idea is simple: that someone from Riacho He Hé can learn, without paying and without leaving town, the tools with which people find work and tell stories today.
There are no dates yet, no places, no open enrolment. When there are, they will be published here. These are the subjects we mean to cover.
